record.reason: This work partitions personal LLM fine-tuning across collaborative edge devices to reduce fine-tuning resource burden, with experiments on edge collaboration and model quality/communication. Its objective is training, not generation/inference serving, and it does not establish inference-time memory/latency improvement. Linked 4-bit inference work is only adjacent.
record.title: Resource-Efficient Personal Large Language Models Fine-Tuning With Collaborative Edge Computing
